WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc22 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

Fix: with a description set to Persian only, the first words no longer fall under the rest (the Persian is wrapped at the width of the tooltip itself, and re-checked one frame after the tooltip lays out). The same bug after a font size change.
New: Persian chat. General > Persian chat (on by default): the chat windows and the edit box get our font (no more squares), and a message with Persian letters is shaped for the reader who has the addon.
Game alerts switch: General > game alerts.
Includes rc7 to rc21.
